title: 第19章 锁灵盒第20章 隐身
content_zh:
“就八两银子。”易长生说。
事实上他觉得八两银子都贵了。
要不是第一次发现这个东西，想着留个记念，他都有点不想买了，毕竟他的银子真的不多了。
“小哥给高点啊，八两真的太低了。”摊贩看了一眼易长生的神色，知道不可能要得更高了，只想再提高一点，八两银子虽然也有得赚，但不多。
易长生见了就将镯子放回原位说：“就八两，不卖就算了。”他说着就要站起来准备走了。
“哎，小哥别，卖给你了，八两就八两。”摊贩一见人快要走了赶紧完成这个交易。
易长生付了钱，将银镯放进怀里，然后继续在摊位上逛起来，这次不用他瞎逛，只要留意那些用虚维之眼查看时，有星光的物件就行。
没过多久，他又发现了一件发出星光的物件。
易长生也不急，去到摊位前，摆出一副随意看看的样子，然后拿起发出星光的玉佩装作细看，实际上就是吸收玉佩上的维点。
他瞄了一眼权杖的星光，多了十几点星光，将它们全都转移到面板上，顿时多出了16点维点。
【维点：24】
易长生心里非常的激动，他就逛了一下街，居然就收集到差不多三个月才能收集的维点。
他平复一下心绪，让自己冷静下来后，就随口问了摊贩一句：“这玉佩怎么卖？”
他打算便宜的话就买，贵的话就算了。
毕竟维点已经吸收回来了，这个物件买不买都行，他只是怕自己错过什么好东西，所以才会问一下价格。
“这玉佩用的可是奇玉。”摊贩看了易长生一眼便说道：“你想要的话，给九百两银子吧。”
易长生直接就将玉佩放下站了起来，转身就准备走人。
“小哥，小哥，你多少钱想要啊，给个价，合适我就卖你。”摊位见人要走了立刻挽留。
“最多三两银子吧。”他觉得就这个价了，再多就觉得有点亏。
“太低了，你要的话五两银子拿去，三两我都收不回来本钱啊。”摊贩拉着人说道。

“就三两，也不知道是什么玉的，看成色一般，感觉都有点不值。”易长生脸上顿时出现了犹豫的神色，看起来像是不想买的样子。
“行，拿去，我这是亏本卖给你了。”摊贩见了立即完成这单交易，先把钱拿到手再说。
易长生付了钱，将玉佩放进怀里，继续再逛。
可能是见到易长生真的买东西，不是瞎逛的样子，其他的摊贩都非常的热情招呼着他过去看看。
易长生扫了他们的摊位一眼就走，一直逛到快到尽头了，又发现了一条木质的珠串上发出了星光。
他在摊位上细看，没有第一时间拿珠串，而是问了一下能不能上手，得到同意后，便看了几件非常像是古物的牌子。
问了一下价格，要三百两银子，而且这个摊贩可能知道这是个好物件，价格没有低下来。
这个价格他买不起，也不想买，就随意又问了一下其他的物件，其中就问到了珠串。
“这条宝珠就八十两银子吧。”摊贩说道。
“也就这个便宜点啊。”易长生问道：“三两卖不卖。”
“八两你要的话就拿去。”摊位想了想便说道。
content_en:
"Just eight taels of silver." Yi Changsheng said.
In fact, he felt that eight taels of silver was too expensive.
If he hadn't discovered this thing for the first time and wanted to keep it as a souvenir, he wouldn't have wanted to buy it. After all, he really didn't have much money.
"Brother, please give me a higher price. Eight taels is really too low." The vendor took a look at Yi Changsheng's expression and knew that it was impossible to ask for a higher price. He just wanted to raise it a little more. Although eight taels of silver could be earned, it was not much.
When Yi Changsheng saw it, he put the bracelet back in its place and said, "It's just eight taels. If you don't want to sell it, forget it." He stood up and prepared to leave.
"Hey, hello, little brother, I sold it to you, eight taels is eight taels." The vendor quickly completed the transaction when he saw that the person was about to leave.
Yi Changsheng paid the money, put the silver bracelet in his arms, and then continued to browse the stalls. This time he did not need to wander around blindly, he only had to pay attention to those objects that had starlight when viewed with the eyes of virtual dimensions.
Not long after, he discovered another object that emitted starlight.
Yi Changsheng was not in a hurry. He went to the stall and pretended to look at it casually. Then he picked up the jade pendant that emitted starlight and pretended to take a closer look. In fact, he was absorbing the dimensional points on the jade pendant.
He glanced at the starlight of the scepter, and saw that there were more than a dozen starlight points. He transferred them all to the panel, and suddenly there were 16 more dimensional points.
[Dimension points: 24]
Yi Changsheng was very excited. He went shopping and actually collected the dimension points that took almost three months to collect.
After he calmed down and calmed down, he casually asked the vendor: "How do you sell this jade pendant?"
He planned to buy it if it was cheap, and forget it if it was expensive.
After all, Wei Dian has been absorbed back, so he can buy this item or not. He is just afraid that he will miss something good, so he asks about the price.
"This jade pendant is made of rare jade." The vendor glanced at Yi Changsheng and said, "If you want it, give me nine hundred taels of silver."
Yi Changsheng immediately put down the jade pendant and stood up, turning around and preparing to leave.
"Brother, little brother, how much do you want, give me a price, and I will sell it to you if it suits you." When someone at the stall was about to leave, he immediately asked him to stay.
"Three taels of silver at most." He felt that this was the price. Any more would be a bit of a loss.
"It's too low. If you want it, take five taels of silver. I can't get back even three taels of silver." The vendor pulled the person over and said.
"It's just three taels. I don't know what kind of jade it is. The color is average and I feel it's a bit worth it." A look of hesitation suddenly appeared on Yi Changsheng's face, as if he didn't want to buy it.
"Okay, take it, I sold it to you at a loss." The vendor immediately completed the transaction and got the money first.
Yi Changsheng paid the money, put the jade pendant in his arms, and continued shopping.
Maybe it was because he saw that Yi Changsheng was actually buying something and not just wandering around. The other vendors were very enthusiastic and invited him to come over and have a look.
Yi Changsheng glanced at their stall and left. He walked until he was almost at the end and found another wooden bead string emitting starlight.
He looked carefully at the stall and did not take the bead string immediately. Instead, he asked if he could get it. After getting permission, he looked at several brands that looked very much like antiques.
I asked about the price, and it was three hundred taels of silver. The vendor probably knew it was a good item, so the price was not lowered.
He couldn't afford the price and didn't want to buy it, so he casually asked about other items, among which he asked about the bead string.
"This orb only costs eighty taels of silver," the vendor said.
"This is the cheaper one." Yi Changsheng asked, "Can I sell it for three taels?"
"If you want eight taels, take it." The stall said after thinking for a while.
